sql.overridePlan.create: INSERT INTO brs.override_plan (name, description, position_id, total, created_by, created, updated_by, updated) VALUES (:name, :description, :positionId, :total, :createdBy, now(), :createdBy, now()) RETURNING id
sql.overridePlan.update: UPDATE brs.override_plan SET name = :name, description = :description, position_id = :positionId, total = :total, updated_by = :updatedBy, updated = now() WHERE id = :id RETURNING id
sql.overridePlan.clone: SELECT clone_override_plan AS id FROM brs.clone_override_plan( :planId::int, :startDate:: DATE, :assignedUsers::int[], :receivingUsers::int[], :createdBy::int, :userId::int)
sql.overridePlan.getPlanStatus: SELECT status_type FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id WHERE op.id = :id
sql.overridePlan.getReceivingUser:
SELECT row_to_json(receiving) receiving FROM (SELECT opu.user_id AS "userId", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, opu.m1_allocation AS "m1Allocation", opu.m2_allocation AS "m2Allocation", (select string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') from flow.user_position up inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where up.user_id = u.id
) AS position FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opu INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opu.user_id = u.id WHERE override_plan_id = :planId and u.id = :userId) receiving;
sql.overridePlan.addReceivingUser: WITH new_user AS ( INSERT INTO brs.override_plan_receiving_user (override_plan_id, user_id, m1_allocation, m2_allocation) VALUES (:planId, :userId, :m1Allocation, :m2Allocation) ON CONFLICT (override_plan_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET m1_allocation = EXCLUDED.m1_allocation, m2_allocation = EXCLUDED.m2_allocation RETURNING override_plan_id) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId;
sql.overridePlan.updateReceivingUser: UPDATE brs.override_plan_receiving_user SET note = :note WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId
sql.overridePlan.deleteReceivingUser: WITH delete_user AS ( DELETE FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId ) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.setEndDateAssignedUser: WITH active_user_plans AS (SELECT opau.id, op.id AS plan_id, op.name AS plan_name, ops.status_type, opau.user_id, opau.start_date, opau.end_date FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id AND opau.user_id = :userId WHERE op.status_id <> 3 AND opau.end_date IS NULL AND opau.start_date <= :startDate) UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user u SET end_date = :startDate :: DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' FROM active_user_plans p where u.id = p.id
sql.overridePlan.insertAssignedUser: WITH new_user AS ( INSERT INTO brs.override_plan_assigned_user (override_plan_id, user_id, start_date, end_date) VALUES (:planId, :userId, :startDate, :endDate) RETURNING override_plan_id ) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.updateAssignedUser: WITH update_assigned_user AS (UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user SET start_date = :startDate, end_date = :endDate WHERE id = :id) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId;
sql.overridePlan.deleteAssignedUser: WITH delete_user AS ( DELETE FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND id = :userId ) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.getOverridePlanAllocationMi: SELECT row_to_json(milestone) AS milestone FROM (select opa.id as "overridePlanAllocationId", opa.milestone_id as "milestoneId", opa.allocation, mt.milestone_type as "milestoneType" from brs.override_plan_allocation opa inner join brs.milestone_type mt on mt.id = milestone_id where opa.id = :id ) milestone
sql.overridePlan.updateMilestone: update brs.override_plan_allocation set allocation = :allocation where id = :id
sql.overridePlan.insertMilestone: INSERT INTO brs.override_plan_allocation (override_plan_id, milestone_id, allocation) VALUES (:planId, :milestoneTypeId, :allocation)
sql.overridePlan.deleteMilestone: WITH delete_milestone_alloc AS ( DELETE FROM brs.override_plan_allocation WHERE id = :overridePlanAllocationId) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId;
sql.overridePlan.approve: UPDATE brs.override_plan SET approved = now(), approved_by = :approvedBy, updated = now(), updated_by = :approvedBy, status_id = :statusId WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.inactivate: UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy, status_id = :statusId WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.findById:
SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM (SELECT op.id, op.name, op.description, op.total, ops.status_type AS status, op.position_id AS "positionId", (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM (SELECT u.id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name FROM flow."user" u WHERE u.id = op.created_by) u) AS "createdBy", op.created, (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM (SELECT u.id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name FROM flow."user" u WHERE u.id = op.updated_by) u) AS "updatedBy", op.updated, (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM (SELECT u.id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name FROM flow."user" u WHERE u.id = op.approved_by) u) AS "approvedBy", op.approved, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))) FROM (SELECT opu.user_id AS "userId", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, opu.m1_allocation AS "m1Allocation", opu.m2_allocation AS "m2Allocation", (select string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') from flow.user_position up inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where up.user_id = u.id
) AS position FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opu INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opu.user_id = u.id WHERE override_plan_id = op.id GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) u), '[]') AS "receivingUsers", coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))) FROM (SELECT opa.id, opa.user_id AS "userId", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, opa.start_date AS "startDate", opa.end_date AS "endDate" FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opa INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opa.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE opa.override_plan_id = op.id GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) u), '[]') AS "assignedUsers", coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(mt))) FROM ( select opa.id as "overridePlanAllocationId", opa.milestone_id as "milestoneId", opa.allocation, mt.milestone_type as "milestoneType" from brs.override_plan_allocation opa inner join brs.milestone_type mt on mt.id = milestone_id where opa.override_plan_id = op.id order by mt.display_order ) AS mt), '[]') AS milestones FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id WHERE op.id = :id) t;
sql.overridePlan.findUserHistory: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(aup))), '[]') FROM ( SELECT opau.id, op.id AS "planId", op.name AS "planName", ops.status_type AS status, opau.start_date AS "startDate", opau.end_date AS "endDate" FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id AND opau.user_id = :userId ORDER BY opau.end_date DESC ) aup
sql.overridePlan.findUsers:
SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(results))), '[]') FROM (SELECT u.id AS "userId", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, u.email, (SELECT string_agg( distinct position, ', ') FROM flow.user_position up1 INNER JOIN flow.position p1 ON p1.id = up1.position_id WHERE up1.user_id = u.id AND CASE WHEN :positionId = 1 THEN p1.id IN (1, 2, 3) WHEN :positionId = 4 THEN p1.id IN (4, 5, 6) END) AS position, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(aup))) FROM (SELECT op.id, op.name, ops.status_type AS status, opau.start_date AS "startDate", opau.end_date AS "endDate" FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id AND opau.user_id = u.id WHERE op.status_id <> 3 AND opau.end_date IS NULL OR opau.end_date >= current_date) aup), '[]') AS "assignedUserPlans" FROM flow."user" u WHERE ( lower(trim(first_name)) || ' ' || lower(trim(last_name)) LIKE lower(:search) OR lower(trim(last_name)) LIKE lower(:search) OR lower(trim(u.email)) LIKE lower(:search) ) AND (CASE WHEN :positionId:: INT IS NOT NULL THEN u.id IN (SELECT up.user_id FROM flow.user_position up INNER JOIN flow.position p ON p.id = up.position_id WHERE ( CASE WHEN :positionId = 1 THEN p.id IN (1, 2, 3) WHEN :positionId = 4 THEN p.id IN (4, 5, 6) END)) ELSE 1 = 1 END)
ORDER BY first_name, last_name LIMIT 10) results;
sql.overridePlan.updatePlanUser: UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user SET note = :note, end_date = :endDate WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :userId
sql.overridePlan.getAssignedUsers: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))), '[]') FROM (SELECT opa.id, opa.user_id AS "userId", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, opa.start_date AS "startDate", opa.end_date AS "endDate", string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') FILTER ( WHERE CASE WHEN op.position_id = 1 THEN up.position_id IN (1,2,3) WHEN op.position_id = 4 THEN up.position_id IN (4,5,6) END ) AS position FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opa INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op ON opa.override_plan_id = op.id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opa.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE op.id = :planId AND up.active IS TRUE GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) u
sql.overridePlan.getAssignedUser: SELECT row_to_json(assigned) assigned FROM (SELECT opa.id, opa.user_id as "userId", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, p.position, p.id AS "positionId", opa.start_date AS "startDate", opa.end_date AS "endDate" FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opa INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opa.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE opa.override_plan_id = :planId and u.id = :userId AND up.archived IS NOT TRUE AND up.primary_flag IS TRUE) assigned;
sql.overridePlan.getReceivingUsers: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))), '[]') FROM (SELECT opu.user_id AS "userId", opu.allocation, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, up.active, string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') FILTER ( WHERE CASE WHEN op.position_id = 1 THEN up.position_id IN (1,2,3) WHEN op.position_id = 4 THEN up.position_id IN (4,5,6) END ) AS position FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opu INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op ON opu.override_plan_id = op.id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opu.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE op.id = :planId AND up.active IS TRUE GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) u;
sql.overridePlan.export: select op.name, u.first_name||' '||u.last_name closer, opau.start_date, opau.end_date, op.total, ops.status_type, (select allocation from brs.override_plan_milestone_allocation opma inner join brs.milestone_query_condition mqc on opma.milestone_query_condition_id = mqc.id and milestone_id = 1 where opma.override_plan_id = op.id) as milestone_1_allocation, (select allocation from brs.override_plan_milestone_allocation opma inner join brs.milestone_query_condition mqc on opma.milestone_query_condition_id = mqc.id and milestone_id = 2 where opma.override_plan_id = op.id) as milestone_2_allocation, json_object_agg(u1.first_name||' '||u1.last_name, opru.allocation) receiving_users from brs.override_plan op inner join brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau on opau.override_plan_id = op.id inner join flow.user u on u.id = opau.user_id inner join brs.override_plan_status ops on ops.id = op.status_id inner join brs.override_plan_receiving_user opru on opru.override_plan_id = op.id inner join flow.user u1 on u1.id = opru.user_id group by op.name, closer, opau.start_date, opau.end_date, total, status_type, milestone_1_allocation, milestone_2_allocation;
